title: Chapter 116
content:
Chapter 116

Zhong Yu's final verdict on the punishment of God Edel had just been decided, and various visions appeared in the sky, and the representative of the will of heaven, the eye of heaven, also condensed some illusory clones.

With the appearance of the Eye of Heaven, all the gods felt extremely terrified. They, who practice the laws of Heaven and are often accompanied by the will of Heaven, how could they not understand that this is the manifestation of the will of Heaven.

What makes them feel puzzled and incomprehensible is that if these gods want to arouse the will of heaven, they must be the powerful gods at the top, and there are special secrets in the powerful gods, and only the powerful gods with relatively top strength can do it. .

In their eyes, this weak, mere fourth-level king, and a mediocre king who ruled hundreds of thousands of people, how could he do such extraordinary things that even gods could not do!

This made them feel very confused, and at the same time, there was faint anxiety in their hearts, which made them realize that the era when gods crushed mortals and emperors kneeled and licked the church might be reversed because of the appearance and reversal of this king in front of them.

This made them panic for a while. This change in the situation will definitely shake their rule over the world, harvest the souls and beliefs of countless mortals, and slaughter them batch by batch as fat sheep. This change in the status quo.

It is very likely that the mortal emperors will crush the gods, canonize and relegate many gods at will, so that the original high status of the gods will never exist, and they will completely fall from the supreme altar and become existences that can be bullied by mortals.

This kind of situation cannot be tolerated by any gods. All the gods vaguely looked down at the mortal emperor who was pronouncing his order to judge the gods.

A murderous aura permeated many spaces, causing the spaces to slightly distort and boil, and the invisible suppression covered the entire ground, making Zhong Yu's original defenses slightly tremble.

However, before following the actions of those gods for the thoughts in their hearts, the situation in front of them has undergone earth-shaking changes. I saw the eye of heaven, with black and purple rays of light surging in the eyes, and faint thunder flickering.

Click! With the sound of thunder, a purple-black tribulation thunder slammed towards God Edel, and there was a crackling sound on God Edel, but he was already dark and dry, with a look of being scorched by the thunder. look like.

God Edel, who had already achieved a divine body and no longer felt the pain, couldn't help screaming.

Under this tribulation thunder that punishes everything in the world, and all living beings under the Dao of Heaven, will be judged, Edelson cannot avoid being tortured to death by the power of the heavenly thunder that destroys the world.

However, this thunderbolt was not the end, but the beginning of more torment, one thunder after another struck at Edel dizzyingly.

His skin was torn apart, and the golden blood of the gods fell to the ground. In the coming year, this place must be lush with water and grass, and maybe some animals or plants will get the chance to produce wisdom or some kind of indescribable evolution because of the blood of the gods. .

Just as God Edson was about to perish under the attack of Tianlei, all the demigods who felt a little sad about the death of rabbits and foxes all took action one after another. They couldn't bear the fate of a god in the hands of mortals.

One after another golden light flickered from the hands of those gods, and after accumulating enough power, they burst out fiercely in the direction of Zhong Yu.

Obviously, they also knew that in the mortal camp in front of them, there was no one who could harm them. The only threat was the mortal king who could borrow the power of heaven and earth!

Therefore, all of them did not hold back, and released towards Zhong Yu with the same target. They had the most powerful attack in their hands, and they just wanted to quickly eliminate this mortal who seemed to have infinite means.

Lest he still have more time and opportunities to release bigger and stronger attacks, causing the gods like himself to be affected, these people who can become gods, which one is not a cunning and experienced person?

After experiencing countless dangerous trials, how could they let the danger slowly form, and then be strong enough to threaten themselves, and overthrow their freshman selves in one fell swoop!

This kind of brainless behavior is not something that can be done by the body. Those who can do this kind of behavior have long been drowned in countless long rivers of history, leaving no trace.

Therefore, the first attack is their most powerful move, and they attack Zhong Yu with the same goal, trying to eliminate this person in one fell swoop, so that he will die before the stronger move is used, and all the crises will dissipate in the invisible.

Countless golden lights composed of mysterious beams shot towards Zhong Yu, it seemed that in the next moment, Zhong Yu was about to perish under the attack of these many divine mansions.

Even Cao Cao and the others in the mid-air looked at the countless divine lights that shot down from the sky, and their hearts were full of despair. Obviously, they didn't think that their emperor, His Majesty, could cope with the attacks of so many gods without any harm!

In an instant, countless people's hearts were raised, including those gods. They didn't know if this unexpected mortal king in front of them would be able to block the full strength of all of them again unexpectedly. The siege with one blow once again created a miracle in mortals!

Sure enough, just when countless divine lights were about to attack Zhong Yu, countless mortals in the sky worshiped the king, and all kinds of visions of human reproduction surged together. The firm package blocked Zhong Yu's body.

And they formed defensive circles one after another, tightly enveloping Zhong Yu, blocking all dangers outside the defensive circles.

This is the manifestation of the will of humanity. As an existence at the same level as the Dao of Heaven, although the Dao of Humanity in most worlds is suppressed by the Dao of Heaven, it is also an existence at two different levels of life from the gods.

Blocking the attacks of some demigods who are not even gods is not too simple, and it is not impossible to describe it as easy.

Therefore, in the horrified eyes of those many demigods, their various attacks were easily taken down by them, who thought they were nothing more than illusions shot by the Dao of Heaven, visions of illusory existences.

It didn't even cause any harm to those intentions, just like eating and drinking water, casually swallowed the attacks composed of their divine power, and then slowly absorbed and swallowed them as if they had to digest after eating, and disappeared in the invisible.

Let those gods who often use divine power to attack, and the effect is very good, almost nothing can stop them, and basically think that their divine power is omnipotent, feel a burst of horror in their hearts, and almost deny their cognition that gods are omnipotent watched.

He fully understands that the seemingly harmless king in front of him is not something he and his demigods can deal with and hurt. Based on their years of fighting experience, all the gods wisely chose to escape this way.

But they should turn into a stream of light and fly away, directly away from this place, or even leave this world and run into the void of the universe, wander for a while to avoid the limelight, and then come back.

But he was shocked to find that after those human visions devoured their attack, they had surrounded them in every escape position without a single gap.

And they are constantly shrinking the space where they can move, as if they want to net them up like fish, and this fishing expert is Zhong Yu!
